name: How do I maintain and seal a newly installed backsplash?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain and seal a newly installed backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grout lines should be cleaned periodically using a pH-neutral cleaner and a soft-bristle brush, avoiding harsh acids that can degrade the cement mixture. If your backsplash features unglazed tile or cementitious grout, apply a penetrating sealer after installation and reapply it every one to two years to prevent cooking oil and grease from penetrating. Backsplashes behind cooktops benefit greatly from stain-resistant urethane or epoxy grouts, which do not require routine resealing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clean with a pH-neutral cleaner and apply penetrating sealer to cement grout and porous stone annually, especially around the cooktop.
